mapper.select: select f.file_id,f.archive_id,f.display_name,f.relative_path,f.store_key,f.file_type,f.file_size,f.sha256, f.create_by,f.create_time,f.revoked, (select max(v.version_no) from arc_file_version v where v.file_id=f.file_id) current_version_no from arc_file f where f.archive_id=#{archiveId} and f.revoked=0 order by f.relative_path,f.file_id
select file_id,version_no,original_name,store_key,file_type,file_size,sha256,create_by,create_time,source_version_no from arc_file_version where file_id=#{fileId} order by version_no desc

select v.file_id,v.version_no,v.original_name,v.store_key,v.file_type,v.file_size,v.sha256, v.create_by,v.create_time,v.source_version_no from arc_file_version v join arc_file f on f.file_id=v.file_id where v.file_id=#{fileId} and v.version_no=#{versionNo} and f.revoked=0
select coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 from arc_file_version where file_id=#{fileId}
mapper.update: update arc_file set display_name=#{version.originalName},store_key=#{version.storeKey},file_type=#{version.fileType},file_size=#{version.fileSize},sha256=#{version.sha256} where file_id=#{version.fileId} and archive_id=#{archiveId} and revoked=0
update arc_file set revoked=1 where file_id=#{fileId} and archive_id=#{archiveId} and revoked=0
mapper.select: select f.file_type e.event_type as name, count(*) as total from arc_audit_event e join arc_file f on e.archive_id=f.archive_id and locate(concat('[file:',f.file_id,']'),e.detail)=1 join arc_archive a on a.archive_id=e.archive_id where a.del_flag='0' and e.archive_id=#{archiveId} and e.event_type in ('FILE_UPLOAD','FILE_PREVIEW','FILE_DOWNLOAD','FILE_PRINT', 'FILE_VERSION_ADD','FILE_VERSION_ROLLBACK','FILE_REVOKE') and e.event_time >= #{dateFrom} and e.event_time < date_add(#{dateTo}, interval 1 day) and a.archive_status=#{archiveStatus} group by f.file_type e.event_type order by total desc

select event_type eventType,actor_name actorName,event_time eventTime,detail from arc_audit_event where archive_id=#{archiveId} and locate(concat('[file:',#{fileId},']'),detail)=1 order by event_time desc,event_id desc

select f.file_id,f.archive_id,f.display_name,f.relative_path,f.store_key,f.file_type,f.file_size,f.sha256, f.create_by,f.create_time,f.revoked, (select max(v.version_no) from arc_file_version v where v.file_id=f.file_id) current_version_no from arc_file f where f.file_id=#{fileId} and f.archive_id=#{archiveId}
select archive_id from arc_archive where archive_id=#{archiveId} and del_flag='0' for update
mapper.delete: delete from arc_file where file_id=#{fileId} and archive_id=#{archiveId}
